buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used during loading isotherm experiment.

salt_name.description: Name or identity of the salt used in the experiment.

process_run_id.description: Identifier of the automated process run (as recorded in eLabFTW).

pump_speed.description: Pump speed setting (text or numeric with units as entered).

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells for each ligand/salt combination.

resin_mass_mg.description: Mass of resin used per well.

ligand_name.description: Name or identity of the ligand used.

total_volume_ul.description: Total liquid volume per well used for loading.

venting_time_s.description: Venting time setting during loading (kept as free text).

pump_duration_s.description: Pump duration for loading (kept as free text).

incubation_time_min.description: Incubation time before measurement (free text including units).

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used across the plate.

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles performed before loading.

ligand_concentrations.description: List of ligand concentrations used across the plate.

measurement_wavelength_nm.description: Measurement wavelength of the plate reader.

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the absorbance-to-concentration calibration curve.

salt_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the salt solution (free text).

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the ligand solution (free text).

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the absorbance-to-concentration calibration curve.

equilibration_cycle_duration_s.description: Duration of each equilibration cycle (free text).

number_of_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations applied across the plate.

number_of_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations applied across the plate.

analysis_status.description: Status of the analysis pipeline for this experiment.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were assembled for database commit (UTC).

summary.description: Key metrics from loading isotherm analysis.

n_ligand.description: Number of ligand concentrations parsed from metadata.

n_salt.description: Number of salt concentrations parsed from metadata.

replicates.description: Number of replicates per ligand/salt combination.

n_plate_wells.description: Total number of wells on the plate (should be 96).

n_used_wells.description: Number of wells used in the analysis (non-empty ligand and salt indices).

n_valid_groups.description: Number of ligand/salt groups successfully aggregated with expected replicates.

r2.description: Coefficient of determination for the fit.

message.description: Human-readable status or error message from the analysis script.

raw_plate_with_mapping_csv.description: CSV with raw absorbance and plate mapping.

loading_isotherm_summary_csv.description: CSV summarizing loading isotherm per condition.

langmuir_fit_results_csv.description: CSV of Langmuir fit parameters per salt.

tecan_data_excel.description: Downloaded Tecan Excel raw data file, if available.

loading_isotherms_png.description: PNG plot of loading isotherms per salt concentration.
